The challenge

Why clinics lose international patient enquiries

Handling international patient leads is a race against time. When patients enquire from other time zones, your clinic is often closed.

  • Time zone barriers

    Enquiries sit unanswered for hours while your team sleeps.

  • Response delays

    Delayed replies turn warm patients into cold leads.

  • Coordinator overload

    Staff spend valuable time filtering unqualified enquiries by hand instead of focusing on serious patients.

  • Missed follow-ups

    Without automation, potential patients slip through the cracks.

This is not a staff failure. It is a system limitation.

WhatsApp is the main channel patients use in many markets, including Turkey, the Gulf and across Europe. But staffing WhatsApp 24/7 is expensive, and every missed message is a missed patient.

A patient who messages at 11pm and gets no reply until the next morning has often already contacted other clinics. The first clinic to reply usually wins the conversation.

The solution

Automate patient acquisition on WhatsApp

We install a dedicated AI-powered WhatsApp system designed for medical tourism. It handles every incoming message the moment it arrives, in the patient's language, at any hour.

  • Replies instantly

    24/7 replies to every enquiry in under 3 seconds, whatever the time zone.

  • Automated qualification

    Sorts patients by treatment type, budget and timeline, and scores each lead.

  • Smart follow-up

    Re-engages patients automatically when they stop replying.

  • High-value routing

    Only serious, qualified patients are handed over to your clinic team.

  • Vision AI photo pre-sorting

    Patient photos are sorted against your doctors' rules and queued for review. Never a diagnosis.

  • Human handoff

    Medical questions, complaints and anything outside its instructions go to a person, with a summary.

Also included

  • Detects the patient's language

    Replies in the language the patient writes in, from 40+ languages.

  • Voice notes understood

    Voice messages are transcribed and answered like any other message.

  • Bookings in your calendar

    Consultations are booked straight into your calendar.

  • Every conversation visible

    Your team sees every chat on your own WhatsApp Business number and can take over at any point.

Medical and privacy guardrails

What the AI does, and what it never does

The AI is a front desk, not a doctor. It prepares patients for your team; your medical team makes every medical decision.

  • Pre-qualification and intake only

    It answers practical questions, collects treatment interest, budget, travel dates and photos, and prepares the case for your coordinators.

  • Never a diagnosis

    It never gives a diagnosis, a candidacy decision or a final price. Photos are sorted against your doctors' rules and always reviewed by your medical team.

  • Medical questions go to a person

    Medical questions, complaints and anything outside its instructions go straight to a person, with a summary. Your team can take over any chat.

  • GDPR and EU data handling

    GDPR-compliant, encrypted and never shared with third parties. Conversations stay in your own WhatsApp Business account and systems.

How it works

A simple 4-step process

  1. 1

    We build it for you

    We connect your WhatsApp Business number and set up and train the whole system within 48 hours of onboarding. No technical skills needed on your side.

  2. 2

    A patient enquires

    An international patient sends your clinic a message on WhatsApp, at any hour.

  3. 3

    The AI replies and qualifies

    The AI replies in under 3 seconds, answers the key questions, sorts the photos and collects the qualification details.

  4. 4

    Handoff to your team

    Qualified patients go to your coordinators to book the consultation. Your team sees every conversation and can step in at any time.
